title: Each original Word lab -> exactly one bilingual English/Vietnamese brief, source-traceable solution, workflow and formulas
contract: One original Word DOCX corresponds to ONE consolidated Markdown file docs/labs/<slug>.md. No README, SOLUTION.py, or separate brief in the output directory.

Every original exercise appears in its original order with: English assignment requirements, faithful Vietnamese translation including all original data/units/tables/formulas, solution code using actual existing teacher DEMO.py or curriculum scripts (or clearly labeled existing reviewed SOLUTION.py only when no runnable demo exists), then step-by-step explanation and relevant formulas BELOW the solution.

Do not invent exercises, data or algorithms. When demonstration is partial or buggy, explicitly identify the mismatch and identify the sourced reviewed function used for the required step; do not attribute invented code to teacher.
Preserve 7 Word-source units only. Two notebook-exclusive labs2 and labs3_4 do not count as original Word labs; duplicate MON 2/LAB SESSION 5_6.docx not counted twice; Pretest.docx not part of labs.
Use original Word-derived LAB.md faithfully without claiming the raw DOCX was re-parsed if only the transcription was verified. Keep PythoClass and labs/pythoclass reference folders unmodified.
Clearly note the Lab04 electricity example 282000 VND conflicts with progressive rate table result 240000 VND, show both rather than silently changing.

Do not conflate a setup script with the per-question code: each question must have its own sourced executable code or exact sourced function and explanation. Identify chapter/file provenance for each answer.
Replace previous docs/labs multi-file exports with one consolidated document per Word lab, preserving earlier PRs as git history. Update the index and tests to the corrected 7-file contract.
Process in at most 3 Word docs per PR, require exact final PR HEAD GitHub Actions CI SUCCESS before merge; record progress per batch. Do not finish goal before 7 of 7.
Windows PowerShell/CDP verification remains UNVERIFIED unless verified by actual worker; do not create duplicate tasks or an unapproved successor goal.
